duration: Ongoing unless and until terminated in accordance with the termination provisions.

payment_terms: party_b earns 12% of collected net revenue from each referred client for the first 12 months after that client starts paying party_a. party_a will calculate commissions based on amounts actually collected, issue a statement, and pay earned commissions by the 15th day of the following month. Chargebacks and refunds may be netted against the next commission payment. Accrued unpaid commissions remain payable after termination.
purpose: Services relationship: operative commitments below follow your notes. party_b will refer qualified B2B clients to party_a. party_a will review and accept or reject each referral in its discretion, and commissions apply only to referred clients for whom party_a actually collects payment. For each accepted referred client, party_b earns commission on the first 12 months of collected net revenue. party_b may not bypass party_a or route the [ADDRESS_1] introduction around party_a. Either side may end the relationship on 30 days' notice. Any commission already earned but unpaid when the agreement ends survives termination.
